opening.argument: The material is presented as an investigation into a bad advertisement appearing in Google search results, not as an offer made by the creator. It shows an apparent eBay result redirecting to a different site associated with a tech-support scam, where the page claims, “Your computer has been locked up” and instructs users to call support immediately. The video reports that the campaign was shared by an anonymous researcher and reported to Google, while the displayed alert and Windows registration-key field are examined as evidence of the deceptive flow. Nothing shown has the creator soliciting payment, credentials, or participation.
